Howard Capital Management Boosted Intel (INTC) Position by $2.11 Million; Chickasaw Capital Management Boosted Stake in Eqt Midstream Partners LP (EQM) by $3.67 Million
April 25, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Howard Capital Management increased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 15.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Howard Capital Management bought 45,911 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 341,941 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.78 million, up from 296,030 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Howard Capital Management who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $240.91 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.045 during the last trading session, reaching $51.495. About 18.67M shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 44.65% since April 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.10% the S&P500.
Chickasaw Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Eqt Midstream Partners Lp (EQM) by 4.04% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chickasaw Capital Management Llc bought 50,292 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.10% with the market. The hedge fund held 1.30M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $94.74 million, up from 1.25M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chickasaw Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Eqt Midstream Partners Lp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.96B market cap company. The stock increased 1.21% or $0.735 during the last trading session, reaching $61.605. About 101,023 shares traded. EQT Midstream Partners, LP (NYSE:EQM) has declined 25.44% since April 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.99% the S&P500.
